title: Savoy Reunion Is Held — Annual reunion of old Savoy College's ex-students
text:
Savoy Reunion Is Held

BONHAM— Annual reunion of old Savoy College's ex-students was held at Savoy last Sunday, and these officers were re-elected: E. A. McMahon, Dallas, president; Mrs. J. B. May, Savoy, secretary; Mrs. Mattie Lee Boyd, Austin, librarian, and Gus W. Thomasson of Dallas, L. J. Reynolds of Arlington, Mrs. J. A. Stinnett and John Humphries of Van Alstyne, board of managers.
notes: Short news brief from the Paris News, June 18, 1944, Page 3. The reunion was held at Savoy and officers were re-elected, suggesting this was an ongoing annual tradition. E. A. McMahon of Dallas served as president. Mrs. J. B. May of Savoy as secretary. Mrs. Mattie Lee Boyd of Austin as librarian. Board of managers: Gus W. Thomasson (Dallas), L. J. Reynolds (Arlington), Mrs. J. A. Stinnett, and John Humphries (Van Alstyne).
